people.name: Jean Regnault de Segrais
people.extract: Jean Regnault de Segrais was a French poet and novelist born in Caen. He was elected a member of the Académie française in 1662.
highlights: Elected to the Académie française in 1662.

people.name: David Marks
people.extract: David Lee Marks is an American guitarist who was an early and latter-era member of the Beach Boys. While growing up in Hawthorne, California, Marks was a neighborhood friend of the original band members and was a frequent participant at their family get-togethers. Following his departure from the group, Marks fronted the Marksmen and performed and recorded as a session musician.
highlights: Early and latter-era member of the Beach Boys.
Performed and recorded as a session musician.

people.name: Christina Obergföll
people.extract: Christina Obergföll is a retired German track and field athlete who competed in the javelin throw. She was World Champion in 2013. Her personal best throw of 70.20 m is the German record. It also ranks her fifth on the overall list.
highlights: Holds German record for javelin throw (70.20 m).
